# Official Source Pins

These repositories were cloned from links in the papers, author project pages, or the official organization. Reproduce the pins with `git -C vendor/<name> checkout <commit>`. The inventory is generated by `python scripts/reference_inventory.py --references references --vendor vendor --output artifacts/reference_inventory.json` with inputs `references/*.pdf` and `vendor/*/.git`.
